_comment: Files under kind 'pdf' are served from public/assets/docs/ on our own domain.
Never overwrite a PDF in place — netlify.toml caches that folder for a week.
Add the replacement under a new dated filename and point 'file' at it.
Files under kind 'link' are third-party investor education, not our documents.
The firm restricted its business to annuities, RILAs and variable universal
life. Documents that only described a business it no longer conducts —
mutual fund breakpoints, mutual fund investing, margin — were removed from
this roster on 2026-09-25. The PDFs are still in the repository and in git
history. See COMPLIANCE.md, 'The scope change', before putting any back.
